definitions.cut_signature: jointly OUT-rooted old/new face labels at offsets -3..2 from the scan cut; null means absent or not completed
definitions.packet_layout: one left cap bit, consecutive three-bit packets, one right cap bit
definitions.row_boundary_mode: top, bulk, or bottom row being consumed
definitions.row_phase: zero-based row index modulo three before consuming the row
definitions.row_weight: sum over segments of 3*dU-2*dRank, minus one row charge
definitions.rule_normalization: width, absolute row and absolute packet position are omitted; cap mode and local boundary effects remain observable
definitions.working_component_debt: non-OUT labels on unretired old faces or completed new faces at the scan cut

limitations: Only n=5 and n=8 are complete equality corridors.
The n=11, n=14 and n=17 results concern one fixed witness each.
An uncovered rule is a baseline support miss, not evidence that the transition is invalid.
The six-face cut window is an observed local signature, not proved sufficient control.
